data.title: 若叶睦 · 集市上的种苗
data.description: 她买到两株小苗，提着纸袋走得很慢，免得叶子碰到袋沿。回去的路上还顺便看了看天气。
data.promptProse: Mutsumi walks along a lively open-air market stall, cradling a brown paper bag from which vibrant green vegetable seedlings sprout. Rustic wooden fruit crates and potted culinary herbs line the sunny cobblestone alleyway in crisp morning daylight.
data.animaCaption: She cradles the paper bag of fragile seedlings against her chest, navigating the market crowd with careful, deliberate steps.
